title: OOP [Final] – Congrats!
description:
It probably was a lot of work, and downright un-fun at some points, but **Congrats!** You have learned C++, From basic cout, all the way to advanced OOP!. Take a moment to practice in the playround below, then answer the question, Congrats!
# Question: Did you learn somthing?

Click this link to go to home: learnhardcode.dpdns.org/

Press this link to go to this projects github (maybe hit it with a star!) github.com/Youg-Otricked/learnhardcode. There is another C++ course! It is on advanced stdlib and preproccesers, such as #include, and #define, along with DSA. Just press next lesson!
hint: Nothing to say. You're Done. Congrats!
